feature: Opt-in exact-width zero values for Rust integer byte-array stores

initial_default_on_speed_failure.decision: Demote correction to named default-off option, as required by repository speed policy. No unchanged-code retry or claim that the result was noise. Native and other validation passed; timings retained in full.

breadth.scope: Recursive paired AST comparison permits replacing only an assignment RHS literal zero with a positive-length repeat of literal zero. Assignment destinations, casts, calls, ordering and all surrounding AST remain identical. Byte counts are recorded; old scalar syntax alone does not prove storage width. This does not prove whole-program native equivalence or arbitrary pointer validity.
limitations: Whole-program native equivalence and full runtime type correctness are not established by structural comparison.
New byte-array element counts are recorded; old scalar syntax alone cannot prove the destination storage width.
The unchanged STORE address must designate valid writable storage; arbitrary pointers are not covered.
Nonzero/nonconstant values, other element types and scalar STORE-width mismatches are outside this change.
Raw inherited parser failures retain diagnostics; identifier-only normalization is review-only.
Registered native proof is x86_64 with Rust overflow-checks=off and C-fwrapv. No multiarchitecture native parity claim.

inspiration: Wide-store parity audit exposed invalid scalar zero assigned to a recovered integer byte array; source-native memory is the oracle.
ablation_scope: Initial default-on 675-assertion corpus; full evidence retained under failed-default-on/
speed_method: Fixed balanced paired final-binary on/off wall medians for zero_unsigned; full CPU/wall comparisons in timing-result.json. Initial failed default-on budget controls the off default.
